title: Everglades Tour

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Bring learning to life with an Everglades field trip built around wildlife, wetlands, and South Florida ecology. Students can experience the greater Everglades region from the water while learning about sawgrass, native plants, alligators, birds, turtles, fish, and the important role this ecosystem plays in Florida.An Everglades field trip gives students a chance to connect classroom lessons to the natural world in a way that feels active, visual, and memorable. Instead of only reading about wetland habitats, students can see the landscape, observe natural conditions, and learn how native wildlife depends on this unique environment.This experience is a strong option for schools, homeschool
